|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card. The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V4-L-jakkutuanulvillage_ai-2022-08-30.png]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
